title: Documentation build failure
summary: Simulate the documentation site failing while code changes continue to land.

trigger.description: The documentation build cannot produce a new preview or deployment.

assumptions: Documentation is part of the project's user-facing continuity surface.
A versioned source archive remains readable without the site.

inputs.name: docs_workflow
inputs.description: Observed workflow and local command for building documentation.

score.formula: 100 minus bounded penalties for missing local build and preview instructions

recovery_actions: Document a local documentation build and preview path.
Keep release notes in a versioned repository path.
limitations: Does not fetch the hosted documentation service.
Does not inspect private deployment credentials.
